Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.label: D'thorga Patches
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.description: Fixes and patches for other authors' mods, each switched on only while that mod is active: aircraft, missiles, outposts, Combat Extended and more. It copies nothing from them.
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.otherMods: Everything in it changes another mod: its README lists each patch, and each patched mod has a page in Options > Mod settings > D'thorga Patches while that mod is active.
